title: Health Innovation Jersey
strap: This house believes that health is the next key industry for Jersey.
desc: A full day of innovators, founders and debate on whether health could be Jersey's next key industry: wellness and alternative health in the morning, the bioeconomic opportunity after lunch, then med tech and digital health into the evening.
Each session closed on a panel debate about the opportunity for Jersey, and scaling beyond our shores.

title: Innovation Breakfast: Isle of Man
strap: A friendly panel debate on innovation for the Isle of Man: past, present and future.
desc: With a General Election coming in September 2026, a changing domestic economy and fast-moving technology, the panel asked how the Island can best embrace the future, and how MHKs and government can help.
Facilitated by James Kingston of CDOT Future, hosted by MannBenham and sponsored by StreamOn.

title: TEKEX Gen #1
strap: The first TEKEX Gen: connecting and inspiring the next generation of innovators.
desc: Our first step in building the next generation of innovators: an evening for 16–24 year olds to explore what innovation means to them, their role in shaping the future, and how to connect with like-minded peers.
Some of Jersey's most influential business leaders shared their stories, challenges and advice, but the point was a space for young minds to come together, not just to listen.

title: TEKEX Summer Social
strap: No pitches, no presentations, no fee. Just connecting with great people.
desc: A summer evening off from the stage, for the network to simply get together.
Thanks to our collaborators PwC, Rathbones, Digital Jersey and C5.

title: TEKEX Gsy #5
venue: C5 Alliance, Admiral Park, St Peter Port
strap: An evening of insight and networking in Guernsey.
desc: From a Dragons' Den winner to the founder who sold Feelunique, a Bitcoin thought experiment and BDO/C5's first digital worker, plus advice on protecting your brand as a start-up.
lineup: Dragons' Den winner: SKIN, the price comparison app
From founding to exiting Feelunique, and Indu
Will Bitcoin drive a multi-planetary future?
How start-ups can protect their brand

title: TEKEX #28: Bootcamp 2024
strap: Pitch night for the 2024 Digital Jersey Bootcamp cohort.
desc: Live pitches from the bootcampers as they released their businesses for the first time, with the audience voting for a winner.
TEKEX collaborates on the Digital Jersey Start-up Bootcamp with JT and PwC.

title: TEKEX #27
venue: C5 Alliance, Windward House, St Helier
strap: Four speakers and the first look at TEKEX Gen.
desc: A digital connection space to meet innovative people and hear their business journeys, from island genetics to agri-tech, with the next generation of TEKEX revealing its purpose and mission.
lineup: Dyneval: genetics, Jersey and our island breed
AVA, the in-house AI changing how C5 works

title: TEKEXmas 2023
strap: Nothing more than a celebration of the year, and your TEKEX peers.
desc: Our end-of-year get-together at Melting Pot.

title: TEKEX Gsy #4
venue: C5 Hub, The Plaza, St Peter Port
strap: AI-powered development, AI work hacks and a TEKEX evolution.
desc: Our fourth Guernsey evening, at the C5 Hub, with Louis Pike teasing the TEKEX evolution that became TEKEX Gen.
lineup: Dexla: build B2B SaaS with natural language

title: TEKEX #26: Happier Healthier Humans
strap: Back with a bang after Bootcamp: health, happiness and investing in both.
desc: Our charity was Ocean Culture Life, introduced by bootcamp winner Tamsin Raine. Nik Rose presented Io-Co's health incubator model and what it could mean for Jersey, and SHUFL Capital talked about fund one and the launch of their second.

title: TEKEX Bootcamp Special
strap: Seven live pitches to close the first Digital Jersey Bootcamp.
desc: As the 12-week Digital Jersey Bootcamp came to a close, the seven shortlisted founders faced their final challenge: TEKEX live. Ten-minute pitches, live Slido voting, food and drinks.

title: TEKEX Gsy #3
strap: A stellar line-up in Guernsey, led by the co-founder of Feelunique.
desc: Aaron Chatterley, who co-founded Feelunique in 2005 and sold it to LVMH/Sephora in 2021, on his new teen beauty brand Indu, alongside three Channel Island founders.

title: TEKEX #25
strap: A new club house, a new year and a brand-new suite of speakers.
desc: Our first event at BDO. Aaron Chatterley on round two of his entrepreneurial journey, Ian Rhodes (formerly an engineer, innovator and CEO at McLaren) on pivoting F1 technology into healthcare, and a med-tech theme carried on by Austin Gibbs.
Our charity was Healing Waves, and the after party was at Ce Soir.
lineup: Austin Gibbs, Heather-Anne Hubbell and Dr Stan Shephard

title: TEKEX-mas
strap: One start-up, two fireside conversations and a thought-leader talk from PwC.
desc: Ending 2022 on a high: Toby Sawyer revealed his new venture, PwC on promoting a diverse and inclusive digital culture, Ed and Tony Moretta of Digital Jersey chewing the fat on tech and Jersey, and Wayne Hennessey-Barrett on 4G Capital's journey from the military to a neobank in Africa.

title: Volunteer Day
strap: A lunchtime celebrating the island's volunteers and charities.
desc: A lunchtime raising awareness of the core island support that volunteers and charities give, ending in open discussion.

title: TEKEX Gsy #2
strap: Our second Guernsey evening, hosted by Northern Trust.
desc: Better periods with less waste, impact investment, and a cyber-security start-up changing how people see their role in protecting a business.

title: TEKEX #24
strap: War stories, new kids on the block and some great thought leadership.
desc: Ticket sales went to the Jersey Women's Refuge, followed by the after party at Ce Soir. Thanks to our partners Digital Jersey, JT and PwC, and to Barclays for food and drink.
lineup: Anova: wellbeing makes good business sense

title: TEKEX #23
strap: Four headline speakers, with all ticket fees to Macmillan Jersey.
desc: Open banking against Visa and Mastercard, strengthening the weakest link in cyber security, and a receipt revolution, with partners JT, PwC and Digital Jersey, hosted by Barclays.

title: TEKEX Gsy #1
strap: The first TEKEX in Guernsey: a celebration of innovation and entrepreneurship.
desc: Hosted by Tom Langford, with thanks to Specsavers for hosting, Barclays Eagle Labs for refreshments and our new partners JT and PwC.
lineup: Digital Greenhouse: the Guernsey Venture Challenge

title: TEKEX #22
strap: The last of 2021, and our first supported by Royal Bank of Canada.
desc: Hosted by Ed Prow, with four founders presenting in turn: augmented reality, NFTs, an accountancy app and green mobility.

title: TEKEX #21
strap: An AI start-up, an incubated fintech, local injury tech and a nano-scientist.
desc: From an app boosting conviction rates to AI for mental health, with a harmonious outlook on fintech and the story of a nano-materials raise.

title: TEKEX #20
strap: Double-decade TEKEX: thought leadership and technology, back in the room.
desc: Our first event back in person after the virtual series, at Santander's Work Café.
lineup: Crowdcube: the evolution of equity crowdfunding
BOPP: the year of open banking payments?

title: TEKEX #19
strap: Our first of 2021 and, we hoped, the last one online.
desc: Channel Island and off-island businesses, from sustainable shopping to Jersey's digital twin.
lineup: Beagle: better products, for people and the planet
Govindicia: how well does your organisation murmurate?
Offshore Simulators and Jersey's digital twin

title: TEKEX #18
strap: An innovative local start-up, some legal tech and Santander.
desc: Access over ownership with a borrowing-and-lending app, five ways to leverage professional knowledge, and a sneak peek at the Santander Work Café coming to Jersey.

title: TEKEX #17
strap: Three main speakers and our local charity, online.
desc: Five minutes from the International Women's Academy, then a fully interactive virtual stadium, a subscription platform for video creators and a scaling Safelink.
lineup: Peter Le Masurier and Rachel Hayden

title: TEKEX #16
strap: Durrell, sustainability benchmarking, MyPay and a virtual stadium.
desc: The last of the summer's virtual events, with Durrell as our charity: reconnecting with nature at Jersey Zoo, then ESI Monitor, MyPay and Virtex Stadium.

title: TEKEX #15
strap: Our first event since Covid-19, and so its dominant theme.
desc: Free tickets with an optional donation to Caring Cooks of Jersey. From a call from the MOD about a symptom-tracing app to equity capital markets in a pandemic.

title: TEKEX #14
strap: Kicking off 2020 with three speakers from colourful tech backgrounds.
desc: Our first event of the decade, and the first with our new venue partner PwC.
lineup: Evie: electric mobility as a service

title: TEKEX #13: Fintech Special
strap: Lucky number thirteen: a fintech special.
desc: Jersey Finance's fintech agenda, the dark side of innovation, and the next generation of escrow.

title: TEKEX #12: First birthday
strap: TEKEX's first birthday, with a top-notch line-up.
desc: A flagship event for our first year, from a former head of the US Marines to The Economist's data designers.
lineup: Colonel Ché Bolden and Jay Aylmer

title: TEKEX #11
strap: Our summer TEKEX, with an environmental tech theme.
desc: Digitalising the agricultural value chain, and rating businesses for their environmental and social commitments.

title: TEKEX #10
strap: Two TEKEX firsts: a guest speaker from the UK, and one live on screen.
desc: John Morris on Smith & Williamson's scale-up programme, Julian Box on his new global venture Vybbe, and Andy Prow (yes, Ed's brother) live on screen on RedShield and its funding round.
